card.title: Playstation 4 Pulsing Blue Light of Death

source.title: Playstation 4 Pulsing Blue Light of Death

claims.statement: PS4 pulsing BLOD causes: a bad hard drive (try booting to Safe Mode with it removed), failed APU solder balls (pressing on the back of the APU makes it boot—reflow/reball), or faulty RAM chips running hot.

procedure: Remove the HDD and try Safe Mode.
Press on the APU area while powering on.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
